title: Christmas at the Plaza
seo_title: Christmas at the Plaza: Sacred Christmas Music, Free
description: Christmas at the Plaza is a celebration of sacred Christmas music titled "My Heart...Your Bethlehem," with three performances over the weekend. The program features a choir, a piano duo, a vocal solo by Stephen Miller, and a cello solo by Connie DeFazio. Tickets are free for the community, but seating is reserved, so call 417-317-9823 to reserve a seat while spots are available.
address: 818 E 32nd St, Joplin, MO 64804, United States, Joplin, MO
